# Chief Complaint
- Wheezing
- Hunger
- Blurred Vision
- urinary frequency
- Fatigue
- Frequent Urination
- Shortness of Breath


# History of Present Illness
Martin117 is a 48 year-old non-hispanic white male. Patient has a history of streptococcal sore throat (disorder), acute bronchitis (disorder), whiplash injury to neck, otitis media, fracture of forearm, acute viral pharyngitis (disorder), viral sinusitis (disorder), sprain of ankle, laceration of forearm, childhood asthma.

# Social History
Patient is married. Patient is an active smoker and is an alcoholic. Patient identifies as heterosexual.

Patient comes from a middle socioeconomic background. Patient has completed some college courses. Patient currently has NO INSURANCE.

# Allergies
No Known Allergies.

# Medications
nda020503 200 actuat albuterol 0.09 mg/actuat metered dose inhaler; penicillin v potassium 250 mg oral tablet; acetaminophen 325 mg oral tablet; clonazepam 0.25 mg oral tablet; insulin human, isophane 70 unt/ml / regular insulin, human 30 unt/ml injectable suspension [humulin]; aspirin 81 mg oral tablet; 1 ml epoetin alfa 4000 unt/ml injection [epogen]; penicillin g 375 mg/ml injectable solution; penicillin v potassium 500 mg oral tablet; ibuprofen 200 mg oral tablet; fluticasone propionate 44 mcg/inhal metered dose inhaler, 120 actuations; acetaminophen 650 mg / dextromethorphan hbr 30 mg / doxylamine succinate 12.5 mg in 30 ml oral solution; amoxicillin 250 mg / clavulanate potassium 125 mg oral tablet; carbamazepine[tegretol]; acetaminophen 160 mg chewable tablet

# Assessment and Plan


## Plan

The following procedures were conducted:
- renal dialysis (procedure)
The patient was prescribed the following medications:
- 1 ml epoetin alfa 4000 unt/ml injection [epogen]
